description: Recommend one exact OpenAI model and effort, plus a budget choice, from a live guide. Guidance updates on use.

interface.longDescription: Get a short, task-specific recommendation of one OpenAI model and effort, plus a budget choice, from the live Model Value Map. Ask for detail to see the tradeoff and the full Revision. Guidance refreshes when used. Optional setup updates your ChatGPT or Codex instructions and adds a monthly refresh task. Savings depend on the task and are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recommend a model and effort for my task using current guidance.
